title: Hands-On LLM cross-chapter capability map

judgmentChain.question: What data actually enters, and are train, validation and test independent?
What representation, system state or parameter set actually changes?
What does the code or loss explicitly reward?
How does output become a decision, and what independent metric tests it?
Which attractive conclusion is not supported by the current evidence?

families.data: Mixed Chinese/English text, emoji, case and numbers
families.transformation: Tokenizer maps strings to vocabulary-specific token IDs
families.objective: Mechanism audit; no training objective in the local practice
families.failureBoundary: Fewer tokens do not prove better semantics, knowledge or reasoning

families.transformation: Causal LM emits vocabulary logits; decoder selects tokens; KV cache retains attention keys/values
families.objective: Next-token likelihood in model training; chain, tensor-shape and incremental-compute checks locally
families.outputDecision: Argmax or sampling to tokens, then text decoding
families.failureBoundary: Generation success is not usefulness or correctness; cache speed is not knowledge quality

families.data: Labeled reviews or unlabeled paper corpus
families.transformation: Encoder embeddings feed centroids, logistic regression, UMAP, HDBSCAN and c-TF-IDF
families.objective: Decision boundary or density-based grouping, not an answer inherent in the embedding
families.outputDecision: Class labels, scores, cluster IDs, outliers and topic keywords
families.failureBoundary: Decision layers change answers over fixed embeddings; clustering scale changes topics; keywords are not ground truth

families.data: Instructions, examples, schema, tool definitions and returned observations
families.transformation: Prompt conditions generation; executor performs deterministic work; observation returns to the model
families.objective: Constraint following and a complete call-execute-observe-answer loop
families.outputDecision: Structured text, tool arguments, execution result and final answer
families.failureBoundary: One-shot is not universally effective; a correct tool result can still be ignored or rewritten incorrectly

families.transformation: Text or image encoders place candidates in a shared vector space and rank by similarity
families.objective: Bring matched items closer and rank them above alternatives
families.outputDecision: Top-k documents, image-text rankings and similarity scores
families.failureBoundary: Highest similarity does not prove an answer exists or a statement is true; reranking cannot recover an un-retrieved item

families.transformation: Encoder parameters move supplied positive pairs together relative to batch alternatives
families.objective: Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss fits the supplied pair geometry
families.outputDecision: Updated vector space consumed by a later retriever or classifier
families.failureBoundary: Wrong positive pairs can lower loss while harming retrieval; in-batch false negatives distort the space

families.data: Sequence labels, MLM masks, BIO labels, chat tokens or prompt/chosen/rejected preference pairs
families.transformation: Task heads change output units; freezing restricts gradients; LoRA learns low-rank updates; DPO shifts relative preference margin
families.objective: Sequence/token cross-entropy, MLM, SFT next-token loss or DPO relative preference
families.outputDecision: Classes, token labels, vocabulary distributions, generated text or adapter weights
families.failureBoundary: Freezing or higher rank does not guarantee generalization; malformed metric shapes and wrong preferences can produce convincing loss/score changes

repositoryChecklist: What final capability is claimed: generation, labeling, retrieval, action or parameter training?
Where does data come from, and are splits, labels, preferences, contamination and licenses explicit?
What does the code actually change: formatting, weights, adapters, indexes, thresholds or prompts?
Does the optimization target align with the business goal, and can loss fall while product quality degrades?
How do decoding, thresholds, ranking, parsers, executors and post-processing turn output into a decision?
Which independent metrics, failure samples, counterexamples and un-reproduced resource boundaries support the claim?
interpretationBoundary: This map synthesizes existing source audits and local proxy experiments. It adds no new original-model reproduction or quality claim.
